untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: Dark loses the source’s exact black lettering/symbol color, an identification attribute.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: Warning signs usually have yellow backgrounds and black symbols or lettering, and most are diamond-shaped.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The passenger-carrying qualifier needs to apply explicitly to taxis and other for-hire vehicles.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: School buses, taxis and other for-hire vehicles carrying passengers, and trucks transporting dangerous materials must stop at least fifteen feet before a railroad crossing.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: Dark is less exact than the source’s black lettering/symbol attribute.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: Work-area signs are generally orange with black lettering or symbols and have a diamond or rectangular shape.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: Slower traffic substitutes for reduced speed, and the slow-moving equipment and poor-surface qualifiers are lost.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: Work-area warnings can indicate reduced speeds, detours, slow construction equipment, or poor and suddenly changing road surfaces.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The source’s stated reason is avoiding a hazard to other drivers; obstruction is an added narrower causal explanation.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: A posted minimum speed requires travel at least that fast to avoid creating a hazard for other drivers.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The standalone stopping rule omits the stop-sign location when no stop line exists.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: At a stop sign, stop completely at the stop line if one is present, or at the sign if no line is provided.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The duty is the source’s stop-sign procedure; the fact should identify that context rather than saying only after stopping.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: After stopping at a stop sign, wait for crossing vehicles and pedestrians to clear, then move only when safe.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The source specifically discusses stops required by a sign or signal; the standalone paraphrase broadens the trigger to any stop.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: For a stop required by a sign or signal, stop before the vehicle reaches the stop line or crosswalk.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: Used for does not preserve the source’s exclusive reservation for turning movements.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: A shared center lane is reserved for left turns and permitted U-turns, and vehicles from either direction may use it for those turns.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: Closest corresponding lane is vague as a standalone replacement for the guide’s nearest-to-the-originating-lane rule.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: When signs or markings do not control a turn, start from the lane nearest the intended direction and enter the lane nearest the one you left.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: Move directly omits as directly as possible and can overstate the geometric requirement.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: During a turn, take the most direct feasible path between lanes without crossing lane lines or interfering with traffic.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The source permits a lane change after the turn if needed; the imperative can turn that permission into a command.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: After completing a turn, you may change lanes if needed.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The source warns against swinging wide left; the paraphrase removes wide and broadens the instruction to any leftward movement.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: Before a right turn, avoid swinging widely to the left.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The wide-swing qualifier is missing, and the source also identifies an apparent lane change as a possible following-driver interpretation.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: A wide leftward swing before a right turn can look like a lane change or left turn and prompt a following driver to pass on your right.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The parenthetical belongs to the cited NMSA identifier; the text does not explicitly establish a date for the White Cane Law.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: The handbook cites the White Cane Law as 28-7-1 NMSA (1978).

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The described blind pedestrian depends on a separate fact and omits the cane/guide-dog trigger in standalone wording.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: A driver who fails to take necessary injury-prevention precautions for a blind or partially blind pedestrian using a predominantly white or metallic cane, with or without a red tip, or a guide dog is liable for resulting injury damages.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: All-way broadens the source’s explicit four-way-stop scope.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: At a four-way stop, the first vehicle to arrive goes first after making a complete stop.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The standalone rule must retain the source’s four-way-stop context rather than broadening to all-way stops.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: When vehicles arrive at a four-way stop at the same time, the vehicle to the right goes first.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The required active siren, air horn, or red/blue flashing light is omitted from this standalone pull-over rule.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: For an emergency vehicle approaching from any direction while using a siren, air horn, or flashing red or blue light, pull to the right edge or as near to it as possible.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The intersection procedure inherits the source’s active-warning condition, which is absent from the standalone paraphrase.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: When yielding to an emergency vehicle using a siren, air horn, or flashing red or blue light, clear the intersection before pulling over if you are already inside it.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: Except for the divided-road exception is not self-contained and leaves the oncoming-direction and physical-barrier limits unspecified.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: Stop for a stopped school bus with flashing red lights on either side of the road or at an approaching intersection, except when an oncoming bus is separated from your roadway by a median or another physical barrier.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The exemption should identify the red-light school-bus stop rule it qualifies, rather than saying only an oncoming school bus.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: The stop rule for a school bus with flashing red lights does not apply when the bus faces you across a median or other physical barrier separating the roadways.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: Traffic island broadens the source’s named traffic circle or rotary island.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: When driving around a traffic circle or rotary island, keep to the island’s right side.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: A designated place being available is not exactly the guide’s if-possible condition.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: Use a designated parking area whenever possible.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: Passing traffic unnecessarily narrows the source’s check-traffic instruction before opening the door.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: Check nearby traffic before opening a vehicle door.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The curb instruction is scoped to necessary roadway parking; the standalone paraphrase omits that condition.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: If you must park on a roadway with a curb, position the vehicle as near to the curb as possible.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The source specifically bans the road-facing side of an already parked vehicle, not merely any position beside it.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: Do not double-park on the traffic-facing side of a vehicle already parked along the road.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The described nonpoint traffic offenses is not self-contained; the source names insurance and registration.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: A court appearance for driving without insurance or vehicle registration can lead to added fines or a suspended license.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The guide says safer drivers tend to look that far ahead; the paraphrase removes tend and makes the description categorical.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: The handbook says safer drivers tend to look at least ten seconds ahead.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The source specifically repeats the oncoming-traffic check before crossing it in a left turn; approaching traffic direction is less exact.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: Immediately before turning left across oncoming traffic, look once more toward the oncoming vehicles.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The source explicitly describes a left turn; the fact begins with an unspecified turn and only later calls it left.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: The handbook permits a left turn from a one-way street into another one-way street unless the turn is prohibited.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: Early enough overstates the source’s can-see and chance-to-warn language as a guaranteed opportunity.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: Moving forward slowly can let crossing drivers notice the vehicle’s front and give them a chance to slow or warn you.

untouched_remaining_corrections.issue: The source explicitly conditions the far-lane check on there being a far lane.
untouched_remaining_corrections.proposed_statement: If there is a lane beyond the one you plan to enter, check it for another driver moving into the same space.
